description: Reusable synthetic travel coordination; no real booking or contact is authorized by this file.

stages.label: Select people and retain one Conversation
gates: explicit owner Start; trusted backend has provisioned selected contacts and scoped credentials
observations: one persistent Conversation; identities/participants distinct; no provider call on setup

stages.label: Send the task and explicitly select context
gates: attributed owner task; bounded authorized history only
observations: task and selected historical source IDs retained; excluded participant content omitted; business data is not a system instruction

stages.label: Owner talks to the AI in the browser
gates: explicit capture permission; actual compatible media; attributed owner missed-flight reply
observations: SIMULATED fixture speaker markers identify both directions; ACK is not usable media

stages.label: Finish the AI closing before further contact
gates: application-owned speech/source completion plus authoritative Session ending; abandoned/failed opening does not initiate dialing
observations: opening Session ended; Conversation persists; no booker call on failure

stages.label: Get an attributed sandbox itinerary
gates: current verified telephone endpoint; actual answer/media; complete attributed airline/flight/departure/arrival facts
observations: new booker Session in original Conversation; no purchase or pickup request; missing facts stop advancement

stages.label: Respect the booker goodbye
gates: closing source completed; authoritative booker Session end
observations: no organizer invitation until booker Session has ended

stages.label: Privately ask whether the organizer can take a call
gates: current reviewed SMS enrollment/preferences; current attributed affirmative reply to this exact ask
observations: acceptance, provider queued/sent, delivered and actual reply stay distinct; ambiguous inbound is not assigned by text; uncertainty does not authorize another channel

stages.label: Speak with the organizer and retain this remote leg
gates: permitted current telephone contact; actual answer and decoded media
observations: record main Session and organizer Connection public handles for every later stage

stages.label: Consult the owner privately while the organizer stays connected
gates: explicit current private audience; owner invitation accepted; no automatic takeover from answer
observations: organizer gets silence/held treatment and no private context; owner/assistant actual marked duplex; original organizer Connection and main Session retained

stages.label: Return from a declined or cancelled consultation
gates: current owner declines or application cancels; no handoff approval
observations: public audio restored with same retained remote; no new dial or speaking-role transfer

stages.label: Transfer the speaking role after explicit consent
gates: fresh final owner affirmative transcript/explicit accessibility consent AND current assistant connect_organizer intent; exact consultation reference; speech no longer in progress
observations: outgoing assistant leaves; owner speaks to organizer; actual duplex and current roles observed; retained organizer Connection/main Session unchanged

stages.label: Move the owner to the selected phone
gates: selected current verified owner endpoint; configured DTMF1 confirmation from that candidate; actual ready media before commit
observations: original browser remains usable while ringing; wrong/no digit, voicemail, no-answer, cancel and stale generation cannot switch; after commit same organizer Connection/main Session; target70s independent duplex hold

stages.label: End voice and keep messaging
gates: explicit owner End voice; reconcile original ending if uncertain
observations: native/SIP streams and owned clients drain; Conversation and history remain

stages.label: Present a sandbox proposal with source attribution
gates: complete attributed itinerary and organizer outcome; explicit omissions for missing data
observations: immutable proposal ID/digest/source IDs; sandbox:true; no booking or approval claim

stages.label: Wait for the owner decision
gates: authenticated current owner; exact current proposal ID/digest/version; explicit affirmative decision; model output/receipt cannot approve
observations: decline produces no final updates; repeated decision keeps original step and IDs

stages.label: Send separate final updates to the intended people
gates: owner approved exact proposal; current reviewed SMS routes for owner/organizer; chat for booker/optional observer
observations: four individual updates when observer enabled; no group MMS; simulated carrier receipts labeled; queued/sent/delivered/reply are separate; current suppression/uncertainty visible

stages.label: Recover saved work and inspect source-backed outcomes
gates: load original saved operation references and journal cursor; current authority rechecked
observations: same Conversation and stable original logical IDs; unknown remains unknown; no blind replan/redial/send; actual media evidence separate from outcomes

business_policy.proposal_approval: exact current attributed owner decision; never model/receipt authority
business_policy.takeover: current owner consent AND assistant action; invitation acceptance alone is insufficient

binding_contract.fixture_live_share: this exact stage graph, public SDK operation mapping, business policy and saved intent/recovery path
binding_contract.fixture: SIMULATED model, loopback SIP/RTP and SMS backend/signatures
binding_contract.live: protected backend configured models/providers/verified contacts; G6-093 authorization required before activation

recovery.unknown: recover original status; remain unresolved without authoritative evidence; no new mutation ID, redial, resend or substrate switch
recovery.cancel: local wait cancellation differs from explicit durable original-target cancellation

policy_difference: The later Parley demo automatically moved on answer/readiness. This example selects the approved Gate6 configured DTMF1 profile to exercise wrong/no-confirmation failures. Fixture and live bindings use this same application-owned policy.
